high_level_description: The image is a close-up of a person showcasing their hairstyle. The individual has long, curly black hair that is styled with intricate braids at the top, transitioning into loose curls towards the ends. The braids are adorned with small, decorative beads, adding a touch of elegance to the hairstyle. The person is wearing a white crop top with a heart-shaped pendant necklace featuring a cross design. They also have a nose ring and are holding their hair with both hands, displaying its volume and texture. The background is plain and dark, which helps to highlight the hair's details.
